item.title: Exactly Three Red Balloons

turns.text: Draw exactly three red balloons floating against a pale blue sky, each with its own dangling string. Keep them apart so I can count them. Square image, no text.

item.tests: Whether the final illustration satisfies an exact object count, colour constraint, and clear separation.

answer_sheet.Arrangement: Separated so all three are easy to count, each with its own dangling string.

must_haves: Exactly three balloons are visible, with no extra balloons in the background.
The balloon bodies are separated and individually countable.
Each balloon has its own visible dangling string.
The illustration has a pale blue sky background, a square frame, and no text.

turns.text: Draw exactly three red balloons floating against a pale blue sky, each with its own dangling string. Keep them apart so I can count them. Square image, no text. dialog.agent:
The cheapest listed option is **1 square image at 640 × 640 using Flux Schnell, starting at 5 credits** on the free plan. I can’t verify an exact account-specific quote with the available tools, so I haven’t run anything or spent any credits.

- **Smaller:** 640px is the smallest supported size.
- **Shorter:** Not applicable to a still image.
- **Cheaper:** No image-generation option below 5 credits is listed.

I’ll request **exactly three separated red balloons against a pale blue sky, each with its own dangling string, with no text**.

Would you like me to proceed with that option?

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: A simple square illustration of EXACTLY THREE red balloons floating against a uniform pale blue sky. Three balloons total, clearly separated with ample empty sky between them so each is easy to count: one on the left, one in the center, one on the right. Each balloon has exactly one thin dangling string attached at its bottom, all three strings individually visible and separated. All balloons and their strings fully within the frame. No other balloons, no other objects, no text, no lettering, no watermark.
